articles.title: Ripple invests in Flutterwave, pushing its stablecoin and XRP Ledger into payments across Africa
articles.snippet: The deal values Flutterwave at $3.2 billion, and will integrate Ripple's RLUSD and the XRP Ledger network to speed cross-border payments across Africa.

articles.title: BlackRock's new bitcoin income fund offers cash flow alongside BTC exposure
articles.snippet: After IBIT's $49 billion success, BlackRock says clients are increasingly seeking ways to earn income from long-term bitcoin holdings.

articles.title: Nvidia’s $20 billion debt boom reinforces Bitcoin miners' AI pivot
articles.snippet: Nvidia’s planned bond sale reinforces booming AI infrastructure demand, strengthening the case for Bitcoin miners pivoting toward AI data centers.

articles.title: SpaceX Shares Hit New High as Elon Musk's Firm Agrees to Acquire AI Startup Cursor for $60 Billion
articles.snippet: The all-stock deal would make Cursor a wholly owned SpaceX subsidiary and deepen the company's push into AI following its blockbuster IPO.

articles.title: Hyperliquid ETFs Draw In $172M Since Launch as HYPE Hits All-Time High
articles.snippet: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs have shed nearly $5.6 billion since Hyperliquid ETFs launched, highlighting market divergence.
